verdict.rationale: Jan exposes an OpenAI-compatible local API server (localhost:1337) intended for other applications to drive it, plus MCP integration for agentic use, but there's no evidence of a public hosted API or formal OpenAPI/swagger documentation (probes for openapi.json/swagger.json and llms.txt all returned 404). Missing for 10: publicly documented OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent third-party corroboration of API usage, and hosted (non-local) API access.
